newsitem.title: CUBA: Frenchman gets 12 years jail in Cuban pornography case.
newsitem.headline: Frenchman gets 12 years jail in Cuban pornography case.

text.p: A Cuban court on Wednesday condemned a Frenchman to 12 years jail for corruption of minors after finding him guilty of taking pornographic photographs of girls aged between 12 and 15 years.
The Cuban news agency Prensa Latina news agency said that Jerome Fitere, 41, was found guilty of five charges of corruption of minors.

Fitere was tried last month in a Havana court and, as is usual in Cuban law, there was a delay before the sentence was handed down. The state prosecutor had called for a 25-year jail term for Fitere, who was arrested in February.
Fitere's trial was held behind closed doors to protect the identity of the minors involved.
A Cuban who was the owner of a Havana private house used by Fitere was condemned to five years jail for being an accomplice in the case, Prensa Latina said.
Fitere, who was in the country as a tourist, was found guilty of persuading a series of young girls to pose naked for photographs and to allow him to touch them.

He was detained at a photographic developing shop in the Cuban capital after staff at the shop refused to hand him prints of a film he had handed in, telling him the contents were pornographic. Fitere became angry and caused some damage to the shop before the police were called, Prensa Latina said.

While there has been a rise in prostitution in recent years because of the increase in tourism to the communist-ruled island and economic crisis among Cubans, there is apparently little child prostitution. Cuban authorities have sought to curb prostitution in the past nine months and are adamant they will not tolerate child prostitution.
